title: TEXASGUNCLUB's "THE ELECTRIC CHAIR" is a mega record with a sound the world will love
htmlContent:
TEXASGUNCLUB's "THE ELECTRIC CHAIR" is a mega record with a sound the world will love. It bridges the gap between high level artistry, and mass appeal to put it in a class of it’s own of must hear music. The song gives you everything you love from multiple genres, as well as it’s own original flavor to make it a song anyone can listen to, and find a reason to love it.
